scope: Remove the premature assistant idle transition at audio TTS end, preserving playback interruption eligibility in the existing message lifecycle.
acceptance_criteria: VAD after TTS end still pauses active output; meaningful STT confirms interruption and flushes the prior context.
Final STT and EOS after confirmed interruption admit user input and start the next assistant generation.
TTS end during pending interruption does not erase interruption eligibility.
Filler-only STT resumes the same context after the existing 500 ms decision window.
Late and duplicate receipts for same-ID segments do not dismiss later active playback.
Terminal audio delivery, send-error policy fallback, TTS watchdog cleanup, and text-only completion remain intact.
risks: Active audio state conservatively persists until turn replacement or cancellation; this patch does not identify actual playback drain.
Direct EOS or user-input packets without prior turn admission no longer inherit the premature idle state. Review found no current EOS producer bypassing speech or typed-text admission.
Playback-driven idle startup and completion metrics remain pending the separately governed completion contract.
No protocol, receipt-authority, interruption-default, or lifecycle-owner change is included.

verification.result: Failed before production fix as expected: TTS end changed active assistant state to idle and VAD bypassed Pause.
passed: test presence and adapter package tests

independent_review.result: No blocking findings or concrete reachable production regressions in the narrow fix.
independent_review.follow_up: Extended meaningful-speech regression through final STT, EOS, user input admission, and next assistant generation. Reviewer checked the addition; updated tests passed.
independent_review.boundary: Direct EOS or user input requires prior turn admission; no current EOS producer bypass was found.
independent_review.scope: Read-only native subagent review of this Standard patch only. This is not approval of RFC0018 or its protocol proposal.

rollback: Revert only this patch's removal of CompleteAssistantSpeech at audio TTS end and its aligned test expectations.
